replies.body:
this is protection from unsupported SDK version, it won't change on the next request.

Assigning and reading a boolean in Python is atomic, so there is no thread-safety issue. The flag is intentionally global as a circuit breaker: if accumulate_event fails due to an unsupported SDK version, we want to stop attempting it process-wide rather than spamming warnings and wasting cycles on every every stream.
